title: Daily Brain #001: three sequences, six points
notes: Answers checked by hand. Easy: each term doubles (3, 6, 12, 24, 48); the gaps (3, 6, 12, 24) double too, so both readings give 48.
Medium: n × (n + 1) for n = 1…6 → 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, 42; the gaps grow by 2 (4, 6, 8, 10, 12), same answer 42.
Hard: multiply by 2, 3, 4, then 5 → 1, 2, 6, 24, 120 (these are the factorials 1!, 2!, 3!, 4!, 5!).
Second solver: checked by a different model than the one that drafted the puzzles; no other simple rule fits all the given terms.
